verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Composio exposing its own hosted MCP server/toolkits for agents to consume (composio-docs-4, composio-probe-3, composio-probe-rt-1) — the reverse of this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers INTO Composio so it can use their tools. No evidence shows Composio importing or connecting to third-party MCP servers as a client.
